statement: The stored readiness evidence persistence guard protects fresher stored evidence only against pure heartbeat and lease lag: a node row whose status or connection state changed replaces the stored evidence at once, so the liveness identity vetoes stale-positive last-known-good reuse immediately, while a lagged row with unchanged status keeps bridging until its ready lease expires; every routed-read bridge witness stays green.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The persistence guard keeps stored evidence only when the replacing snapshot carries the same node status and connection state with an older heartbeat or lease; any status or connection transition replaces the stored evidence.
